facts: Microsoft's product page positions the laptop for local AI workloads and 3D graphics.
The display is a 15-inch touchscreen optimized for touch interaction; pen input and Surface Pen compatibility are not supported.
Microsoft Learn lists three USB-C ports, USB-A, HDMI, an SD card reader, and a 3.5 mm headphone jack.
Microsoft describes published repair guides and upgradeable storage; replacement components and service options vary by market and over time.
